message.content:
Based on the provided image of the Brand Monitor dashboard, here is a list of all visible visual problems:

**Problem** | **Element** | **Severity**
--- | --- | ---
Vertical text overflow / Watermark bleeding through | Main content area (behind "Reputation intelligence" header) | **High**
Text truncation / Content spilling out | Sidebar "PLAN" section description ("Your reputation, monitored 24/7...") | **Medium**
Overlapping elements / Z-index issue | Red "1 Issue" notification badge overlapping the bottom of the sidebar container | **Medium**
Misalignment / Awkward spacing | Top navigation bar (uneven vertical alignment between logo, search bar, and action buttons) | **Low**
Broken layout / Skeleton state rendering | Main content cards (Skeleton loaders appear misaligned with the left border and lack proper padding) | **Low**
Text overflow / Truncation | Breadcrumb text ("HARCHIQ INSIGHT ENGINE · BRAND MONITOR") appears slightly cramped against the left edge | **Low**
